function.name: parse_and_strip_nokspeak
function.description: Scans raw conversational text outputs from multi-agent swarms to extract meta-cognitive NokSpeak v2.1 epistemic tokens and returns a sanitized string for human users.

text.description: The unparsed string context generated by the source agent node containing trailing or inline epistemic tokens (e.g., 'Record updated. savref++:sys').
